All 9 tests pass. Implementation summary:

- **`src/lib.rs`** — just declares `pub mod graph;`
- **`src/graph.rs`** — `Graph` struct with public `nodes: Vec<Node>`, `edges: Vec<Edge>`, and `attrs: HashMap<String, String>` fields. Builder methods `with_nodes(&[Node])`, `with_edges(&[Edge])`, and `with_attrs(&[(&str, &str)])` each take `self` by value, apply the setting, and return `self` for chaining. `node(&str)` looks up a node by name and returns `Option<&Node>`.
- **`src/graph/graph_items.rs`** — declares and re-exports the `edge` and `node` submodules.
- **`src/graph/graph_items/node.rs`** — `Node` with a `name` and an attrs `HashMap`; `new(name)`, `with_attrs(...)`, `name()`, and `attr(key) -> Option<&str>`. Derives `Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq` so it works in `assert_eq!` and `vec!`.
- **`src/graph/graph_items/edge.rs`** — `Edge` with `from`/`to` endpoints plus the same attrs builder/lookup API.

No new dependencies were needed. I ran `cargo test -- --include-ignored` since the tests are marked `#[ignore]`; all 9 pass.
